title: The naive cotangent complex of a presentation commutes with localization at one element
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, $P=A[x_s,\ s\in S]$ a polynomial ring over $A$ and $\alpha:P\to B$ a surjective homomorphism of $A$-algebras with kernel $I$. For such a presentation write $\mathrm{NL}(\alpha)$ for the two-term complex of $B$-modules $I/I^2\to\Omega_{P/A}\otimes_PB$, $f\bmod I^2\mapsto\mathrm df\otimes1$ ($\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]). Let $g\in B$, let $B_g$ be the localization of $B$ at the powers of $g$, choose $f\in P$ with $\alpha(f)=g$, and let $\beta:P[x]\to B_g$ be the homomorphism of $A$-algebras which is $\alpha$ followed by $B\to B_g$ on $P$ and sends the new variable $x$ to $1/g$; let $J=\ker\beta$. Then $\beta$ is surjective, $J$ is generated by $I$ and $fx-1$, and: (1) $J/J^2=(I/I^2)_g\oplus B_g\,(fx-1)$ as $B_g$-modules, where $(I/I^2)_g=I/I^2\otimes_BB_g$ maps to $J/J^2$ by the map induced by $I\subseteq J$, and the second summand is free of rank $1$ on the class of $fx-1$; (2) $\Omega_{P[x]/A}\otimes_{P[x]}B_g=(\Omega_{P/A}\otimes_PB_g)\oplus B_g\,\mathrm dx$; (3) these decompositions can be chosen so that $\mathrm{NL}(\beta)\cong\mathrm{NL}(\alpha)\otimes_BB_g\oplus(B_g\xrightarrow{\ g\ }B_g)$ as complexes of $B_g$-modules. In particular, since $g$ is a unit of $B_g$, the map $(I/I^2)_g\to\Omega_{P/A}\otimes_PB_g$ of $\mathrm{NL}(\alpha)\otimes_BB_g$ is injective if and only if the map $J/J^2\to\Omega_{P[x]/A}\otimes_{P[x]}B_g$ of $\mathrm{NL}(\beta)$ is injective, and the two maps have isomorphic cokernels.
